items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: I did. His brother, well he worked with Papa Celestine a lot. He was, in other words, played second with Papa Celestine most of the time.

ctx.x: What about Chris Kelly? Who did he have in his band? Do you remember any of those fellas at all?

No. Chris had so many of them. What about Guy Kelly? Do you remember any of the fellas? I did. His brother, well he worked with Papa Celestine a lot. He was, in other words, played second with Papa Celestine most of the time. What did you say about his brother?
Chris? Yeah. Didn't you say something about brother and Guy there?
